image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) on sandy ground. The beetle exhibits metallic green elytra with cream-colored markings, a bronze/reddish thorax and head, large compound eyes, prominent mandibles, and long slender legs. The background is blurred sand, indicating shallow depth of field.
